rooms.name: Cellar
rooms.description: A damp cellar. Stone steps lead up.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.description: A kitchen with a cold stove. A trapdoor in the floor opens to the cellar; a doorway leads east.

rooms.name: Great Hall
rooms.description: A long hall hung with faded banners. A heavy oak door stands to the north.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.description: Shelves climb into the dark. On a reading desk, something glitters.

rooms.name: Garden
rooms.description: An overgrown garden, bright after the hall.
